title: Whispering Whelk Waltz
statement: A pearl-shelled sea snail the color of weak tea and moonlight, who hums softly as she glides in slow circles across a sandy stage, trailing a thread of glowing plankton like a ribbon. Her tank is a small lamp-lit ballroom of tumbled shells, swaying kelp and a single cracked teacup, where every bubble that rises is a quiet note in a song only the patient can hear.
